exclusions.source_text: Participants ≥ 18 and ≤ 55 years old will be enrolled.
Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected patients are eligible to participate if they are on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within the prior 6 months

women of child-bearing potential must agree to use adequate contraception (hormonal or barrier method of birth control; abstinence; partner vasectomy) prior to study entry and for the duration of study participation.
Prior invasive cancer ≥ T1 (other than non-melanoma skin cancer), unless curatively treated, and all treatment was completed \> 5 years prior to enrollment
exclusions.threshold: treatment completed > 5 years prior to enrollment

exclusions.source_text: Pregnant women are excluded from this study
Breastfeeding should be discontinued if the mother is treated with tamoxifen
History of uterine cancer or atypical uterine hyperplasia with uterus intact
